operations.command: set -e; test -f /etc/nixos-installer/prebuilt.json; jq -e '."{{prebuiltHost}}-Secure-Boot".system and ."{{prebuiltHost}}-Standard-Boot".system' /etc/nixos-installer/prebuilt.json > /dev/null && printf manifest-ok

set -e; for target in Secure-Boot Standard-Boot; do for field in system disko mount; do path=$(jq -r ".\"{{prebuiltHost}}-$target\".$field" /etc/nixos-installer/prebuilt.json); test -e "$path" || { echo "missing $field for $target"; exit 1; }; done; system=$(jq -r ".\"{{prebuiltHost}}-$target\".system" /etc/nixos-installer/prebuilt.json); nix-store --query --requisites "$system" | xargs -r nix-store --check-validity; done; printf closure-ok

set -e; path=$(jq -r '."{{prebuiltHost}}-Secure-Boot".system' /etc/nixos-installer/prebuilt.json); nix-store --query --requisites "$path" | grep -qE 'linux-[0-9.]+-valve2' && nix-store --query --requisites "$path" | wc -l | awk '$1 > 500 {print "closure-complete"}'
